{"metadata":{"description":"WeCom AI Bot text and image bridge for DeepSeek Harness","id":"gh:1333338828","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"DeepSeek-harness-wecom","slug":"sliverp/DeepSeek-harness-wecom","topics":["chatbot","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","typescript","wecom","wework"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"WeCom AI Bot text and image bridge for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DeepSeek Harness WeCom"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"中文 | English"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"An independent out-of-tree DeepSeek Harness channel plugin that connects a WeCom AI Bot to persisten"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"t Harness agents through the official WebSocket long-connection SDK."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- Official `@wecom/aibot-node-sdk` long connection
- Bot ID + Secret authentication, heartbeat, and "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"reconnect handling
- Single-chat and group text messages
- Mixed text/image input
- Official encrypt"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ed image, file, and video download with AES decryption
- Durable Harness image attachments
- Decrypt"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"ed inbound files saved outside the workspace and exposed to Agent tools by absolute path
- Automatic"},{"id":"p6s5","text":" text-only fallback when the selected model cannot accept images
- Text and inline image replies, pl"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"us uploaded active image sends for other image formats
- A WeCom-turn-scoped `wecom_send_file` tool "},{"id":"p6s7","text":"with workspace containment and file-size checks
- WeCom Markdown replies through the official stream"},{"id":"p6s8","text":" response fields
- One persistent Harness session per single or group conversation
- Harness agent-p"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"reset composition for the same tools, prompts, and skills as Web sessions
- Safe reuse of a live ses"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"sion already opened by Web, without a second session writer
- Same-conversation `/approve <code>` an"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"d `/reject <code>` decisions for one-shot tool approvals
- `/new` and `/reset` rotation to a new dur"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"able session while retaining old history
- Configurable forwarding of Harness commands registered by"},{"id":"p6s13","text":" the current agent preset; `/compact`, `/goal`, and `/plan` are enabled by default
- Per-conversatio"},{"id":"p6s14","text":"n ordering, duplicate suppression, retries, and bounded timeouts
- Open, allowlist, or disabled acce"},{"id":"p6s15","text":"ss policies for single and group traffic
- `/bot-ping`, `/bot-image-test`, `/bot-file-test`, `/bot-h"},{"id":"p6s16","text":"elp`, `/bot-status`, and `/bot-cancel`
- Optional welcome text for the WeCom `enter_chat` event
- Se"},{"id":"p6s17","text":"cret resolution through the Harness credential service instead of plugin configuration

- pnpm 10.33.4
